floater.title: RmlUi Test Window (Development)
floater.string: RmlUi test window
Count
Adds one to the number beside the button. Right click for the window's own menu.
An option
A check box bound to the data model (it changes nothing).
Amount
A slider bound to the data model. The number beside it follows, and you can type a number there (Enter) to set it.
Text
Type here. Japanese input (the IME) works too: compose, convert and confirm.
Switch Colour
Sets the accent colour's CSS variable from the viewer, and back.
Switch Text Size
Switches the body text's size variable, and back.
The host's parts: the log, the search field, the number box and the cut name (research/387).
Add a log line
Adds a line to the read-only log below (it follows its end).
Read-only text: select it, copy it (Ctrl+C or the right click menu); keys do not change it; the arrows and Page Up / Down scroll it.
Log line [N]
Search
Selects all when it gets the focus (click, Tab).
Number
0 to 200 in steps of 5. The arrows (hold them), the wheel, Up / Down, Esc, and 10*3 + Enter work.
A very long name that does not fit in the narrow box: the tool tip shows all of it
1000 rows: only the visible ones are made.
Row [N]
RmlUi is not used in safe mode.
The page could not be loaded (the log says why).
